meta.title: About us | AZAFCO International, Egyptian fish since 2008
meta.description: Exporting since 2008, AZAFCO International farms, sources, packs and exports fresh Egyptian fish to 7+ markets, with 2,500 t/month packing capacity.

hero.title: About AZAFCO International: fish farming, sourcing, packing and export in Egypt
hero.intro: Whole fresh fish for importers, distributors and foodservice buyers across the Middle East and beyond.
hero.image_alt: Two workers pulling a seine net full of fish to the bank of an earthen pond

glance.title: Company facts
glance.activity_value: Farms, sources, packs and exports whole fresh chilled fish.
glance.species_value: 12 main species: {species}. Other species on request.
glance.capacity_value: Up to 2,500 t/month. A refrigerated truck carries 20 t, and on some days more than five leave the plant.
glance.certificates_value: Holds ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

journey.title: Milestones since 2008

journey.baltim: First factory opened in the Baltim Industrial Zone, Kafr El Sheikh

businesses.title: Fish is our core business
businesses.p2: We also grow fruit and vegetables, run livestock farms in Egypt and have other investments.
businesses.image_alt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice seen from above

footprint.title: Our plant, trucks and cold stores
footprint.p1: Our plant is in the Motobas Industrial Zone, Kafr El Sheikh, in the Nile Delta. We wash, ice, grade, pack and inspect the fish there before loading.
footprint.p2: We run our own refrigerated trucks and cold stores, from the plant to air or road freight.
footprint.image_alt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice in white insulated boxes in a packing hall
footprint.map_link: See the plant on Google Maps
